primary_scope: all independent test-word fixed IMU windows, no activity-based sample removal
support_rule: Correct supervision must improve paired target-cluster EER and AUC over each primary control (95% interval in beneficial direction), with no worse mean HTER. Otherwise report partial effects separately, no threshold/model search.
uncertainty_unit: ten target users, average three seeds before resampling; not windows or frames
time_prior_budget: non-parametric reference; all three trained CNN arms match architecture, initialization, batch indices and 400-step optimization
limitations: historical cohort; same 10-person closed background; affine teacher clock not independently physically calibrated; user-dependent auth thresholds use separate development words
